scenarios.title: Open the web server
scenarios.summary: Plain HTTP to port 80. The allow-web rule matches, the first request is read (Host: 10.10.2.10), and the connection moves to the fast path.

scenarios.title: Visit shop.test over HTTPS
scenarios.summary: The engine waits for the TLS ClientHello, reads the server name (SNI) shop.test, finds it isn't blocked, and hands the connection to the kernel.

scenarios.title: Visit evil.test over HTTPS
scenarios.summary: The traffic is encrypted, but the ClientHello names the site in plain text. evil.test is on the blocklist, so the connection is reset.

steps.label: HTTPS to evil.test
steps.output: curl: (35) Recv failure: Connection reset by peer

scenarios.title: Hide evil.test on port 8443
scenarios.summary: Moving to a non-standard port doesn't help: TLS is recognised by its first bytes, not by the port number. Subdomains of a blocked domain are blocked too.

steps.label: HTTPS to cdn.evil.test:8443
steps.output: curl: (35) Recv failure: Connection reset by peer

scenarios.title: Reach tracker.test over plain HTTP
scenarios.summary: For unencrypted HTTP the engine reads the Host header of the first request.

steps.label: HTTP with Host: tracker.test
steps.output: curl: (56) Recv failure: Connection reset by peer

scenarios.title: Look up names over DNS
scenarios.summary: DNS queries are checked one by one and never offloaded. A query for a subdomain of a blocked domain is refused.

scenarios.title: Try telnet and SSH
scenarios.summary: Telnet matches a reject rule and gets an immediate TCP reset. SSH matches no rule, so the default policy drops it silently.

scenarios.title: Connect from a quarantined host
scenarios.summary: Traffic from 10.10.1.66 matches the first rule and is dropped, whatever it is.

steps.label: HTTP from 10.10.1.66
steps.output: curl: (28) Connection timed out after 3005 milliseconds

scenarios.title: Change the rules while it runs
scenarios.summary: A rule added through the API applies immediately, including to connections that were already open: cached verdicts are flushed and re-checked.

steps.label: Add a rule at the top
Request the home page
steps.output: curl: (7) Failed to connect to 10.10.2.10 port 80 after 0 ms: Couldn't connect to server

scenarios.title: Launch a SYN flood
scenarios.summary: 3,000 connection attempts at 2,000 per second. The token bucket lets a burst through, refuses the rest, and after 200 refusals bans the source in the kernel.

steps.label: Request the home page while banned
steps.output: curl: (28) Connection timed out after 3002 milliseconds

scenarios.title: Download at full speed
scenarios.summary: A 3-second iperf3 transfer. Only the first packets of each connection reach the engine; the kernel forwards the rest.
